cohort: 1238 women seen in a tertiary urogynaecological center for urodynamic testing
finding: While vaginal parity was significantly associated with MUP, the effect of childbirth on urethral sphincter function seems to be largely due to the first vaginal birth, and no significant effect of instrumental delivery was found.
mod_finding: No significant effect of instrumental delivery (vacuum or forceps) on maximum urethral pressure was found.
